objective: Test the mechanism exposed by AL without changing solver semantics: determine whether exact DP followed by the already frozen proof-carrying R33 simplifier is sufficient to return every reachable transition in the frozen 15-root domain to terminal/affine status or the AI signed-incidence class. Preserve the first explicit witness if RUP/SA-BVE or another later cheap layer is genuinely required.
frozen_domain: Exactly the inherited AH/AI/AJ/AK/AL 15-root graph-PHP domain and deterministic generation. No family, seed, budget, selector order, success threshold, or reduction rule may be added or changed after outcomes.

transition.candidate_order: Variables sorted by AJ local RAW_S_UB then variable id; no SAT truth or model information.
transition.stage_1: Materialize the existing exact-DP transition for candidate x and require the independent exact-DP replay already used by Y/AL.
transition.stage_2: Apply exactly one complete call to the frozen r33.simplify fixpoint on the exact-DP child. Do not invoke RUP or SA-BVE while deciding whether this candidate supplies the AM certificate.
transition.success_for_candidate: The post-R33 state is a declared R33 terminal, recognized affine terminal under the already inherited affine recognizer, or a stalled residual that satisfies the frozen AI signed-incidence class under the original root budget.
transition.selection: Choose the first candidate in frozen order satisfying the post-R33 certificate. Only after selection may the inherited full cheap policy be replayed as an external consistency check.

certificate.proof_objects: Exact-DP replay record plus full R33 history records, rule counts, certificate bytes, strict-progress flag, and post-R33 AI-class record when nonterminal.
certificate.independent_verifier: Recompute exact DP and r33.simplify from the parent state independently and require identical transformed formula, identical R33 final formula, identical terminal label, strict-progress validity, and equality of canonical hashes. For a nonterminal certificate require post-R33 AI class membership.

AL_gap_diagnostic_control.diagnostic_rule: Do not assume R33 is the source of this recovery. AM must explicitly report the R33 history/rule counts on this control. If R33 alone does not recover the AI class, seal that fact rather than widening the certificate.

polynomial_ledger.scope: Ledger polynomiality is evaluated only in the current representation and frozen finite domain. It is not a proof of global polynomial SAT runtime.

pass_condition: All 15 frozen roots complete with zero semantic mismatch; every reachable nonterminal residual has at least one candidate for which exact DP followed only by frozen R33 yields terminal/affine or an AI-class residual; all exact-DP/R33 replay and ledger checks pass.
result_policy: Do not add RUP/SA-BVE to AM after seeing an R33-only failure. Such a failure becomes the next mechanistic gate. A finite AM pass is evidence only on the frozen reachable domain and is not universal closure or a polynomial SAT theorem.
